Figure1: SafeOT-Dual adds rollout-derived budget prices to observed-cost feedback. The upper-left schematic illustrates fixed-step feedback lag; the projection yields a target flow, while clipped and filtered duals price the actor. Curves show task medians and interquartile bands of seed-mean cost. Final normalized return differences versus TRPO-Lag have 95\% intervals, not equivalence guarantees. Primary violation ratios, curve cohorts and return estimands differ; Appendix specifies each.
Figure2: One flow solve supplies budget shadow prices to a standard actor update. Gray components perform rollout, GAE, feedback and PPO/TRPO; the teal projection changes target visitation, which is not executed. Here $L$ is episode length, $\varepsilon$ the KL weight, $\eta$ the illustrative fixed feedback step, $c$ the price cap, and $B_k$ the episode budget. Benchmark hard-edge masks $H$ are empty. Implementation feedback may use Adam; clipping and EMA produce $\bar\lambda^\star$.
